exposure: placenta previa without prior cesarean delivery
prior cesarean delivery with placenta accreta
cohort: Delivery hospitalizations in the National (Nationwide) Inpatient Sample from 2000 to 2019
finding: Despite an increase in postpartum hemorrhage and related risk factors over a 20-year period, blood transfusions and hysterectomy rates for postpartum hemorrhage decreased in recent years.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with postpartum hemorrhage and related interventions, such as blood transfusions and peripartum hysterectomy.
